stays_and_why: TilemapPanel casts of gSceneCamera: shared headers type it as another camera view
position pointer to the stack struct (without it agbcc keeps the 6-byte struct in registers); (u8)animation casts give the ROM's second register copy
inline kind predicate: ROM materializes each comparison as a bool; plain || or switch does not
flag accessors and clear helper: ROM loads the s32 mask before the byte and materializes the test; plain &= folds the mask to 0xFE
